program.title: BEng in Civil Engineering
uncertain: total_required_credits is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all groups (using the lower bound for credit ranges such as 3-5, 4-7 and 1-4).

Several blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. COMP block, MATH block, PHYS block, CIVL 4910/4920, CIVL 4900/UROP 1100), so the actual credits taken by a student may differ from the calculated total.

The Research Option requires a CGA of 3.15 or above to enroll and is optional ('Students may opt to graduate with or without an option'); its 4 credits are included in the calculated total, but a student graduating without an option would not take them.
The CIVL Electives group (9 credits) and the Research Option Advanced Electives group (3 credits) do not have specific course lists in the PDF, so their courses arrays are empty.
Remarks in the PDF note that COMP 1022P and MATH 1012 were last offered in 2024-25 and deleted subsequently; they are kept in the lists as printed in the PDF.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 CIVL (4Y) (2024-25 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2024-25 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2024-25 per the intake year.

groups.note: Note: CIVL 4900 OR UROP 1100. Students with CGA of 3.15 or above may apply for enrollment in the Research Option. They should declare their intention to enroll in the Option no later than the first term of their third year of study. In addition, students should take CIVL 4920 as specified in the major requirements. Students who take an option MUST complete all requirements specified in addition to the major requirements.
